Summarize biovolumes from the in-memory cache

Source: R/biovolume_cache.R
summarize_biovolumes_cached.Rd

Reproduces the output of summarize_biovolumes() (which wraps iRfcb::ifcb_summarize_biovolumes()) without touching the disk: per-ROI biovolumes are joined with the (possibly corrected) classifications, carbon is converted per ROI with the diatom or non-diatom formula, and the result is aggregated per sample and class.

Usage

summarize_biovolumes_cached(
  cache,
  classifications,
  taxa_lookup,
  non_bio_classes = character(0),
  pixels_per_micron = 2.77,
  diatom_status = NULL,
  custom_classes = NULL
)

Arguments

cache

List from build_biovolume_cache().

classifications

Data.frame with sample_name, roi_number, class_name (from read_h5_classifications(), possibly corrected).

taxa_lookup

Taxa lookup data.frame (see summarize_biovolumes()).

non_bio_classes

Character vector of non-biological classes to exclude.

pixels_per_micron

Conversion factor from pixels to microns.

diatom_status

Optional data.frame from resolve_diatom_status(); resolved on the fly (WoRMS lookup) when NULL.

custom_classes

Optional data frame of custom classes with an is_diatom column (extends the local diatom genus list).

Value

A data.frame with the same columns as summarize_biovolumes().

Details

ROIs without a classification row – including all ROIs of samples the user has excluded – are dropped, matching the file-based path where such rows either never enter (excluded samples) or are discarded downstream by the name-based aggregation (NA class).
